## Goal
- Execute the owner's 15-section FINAL EXECUTION, REAL-DATA RECOVERY, OUTREACH CONTROL, AND PRODUCTION VERIFICATION mandate: freeze fake data, separate funding targets from investor money, audit all investor records, build outreach approval gate, verify 3 real deals, create financial ledger, verify autonomous runs, generate AI architecture map, confirm Expo is sole mobile product, deploy all corrections, and emit 17-section evidence report.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — this is the existing live IVX production project (plan_md confirms 32+ completed milestones); the `<new_project>` system tag is incorrect for this state
- Do not claim VERIFIED without live evidence; do not send investor outreach until owner approves the verified production queue
- TEST and INVALID records must never appear in production dashboards (quarantined via `isProductionVisible()`)
- Only `escrow_received` or `bank_received` with `reconciliationStatus='reconciled'` counts as Funds Received
- Funding targets (Capital Being Sought) must be displayed separately from investor money (Committed/Funds Received)
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Phrase-gated actions: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_OWNER_SUPABASE_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION, CONFIRM_IVX_PRODUCTION_APPROVAL, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE
- Owner session: POST /api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login (email-only) → /tmp/owner_at (len=1620), sessions expire ~15min
- Working directory: /home/user/rork-app

## Key Decisions
- Built financial ledger as independent store from CRM scoring — only reconciled escrow/bank counts as funds, evidence required for every transaction
- Investor classification quarantines TEST+INVALID via `isProductionVisible()` — single filter every dashboard must call
- Outreach guardrails are hard blocks (409 + reason) not soft warnings — DNC, unsubscribe, bounce suppression, duplicate prevention, daily/domain caps, timezone-aware all evaluated before any send
- 7-category separation replaces single "Investor Pipeline" number — funding targets never combined with investor money
- GitHub commit via developer-deploy/action API requires nested `input` object: `{action, confirm:true, confirmText, input:{branch, path, content, contentEncoding:"base64", message}}` — NOT top-level fields
- Render deploys commit-by-commit; hono.ts wiring commit took ~90s to go live after first file commit
- `render_restart_service` requires phrase `CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE` (different from `CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY`)
- No code changes to existing files except hono.ts (route wiring only) — all new functionality in new files

## Next Steps

Emit final 17-section evidence report (EXECUTIVE RESULT, REAL-DATA COUNTS, INVESTOR AUDIT RESULTS, FINANCIAL RECONCILIATION, OUTREACH APPROVAL STATUS, AUTONOMOUS RUN AUDIT, AI ARCHITECTURE MAP, OWNER AUTH TESTS, DATABASE AUDIT, GITHUB PROOF, RENDER PROOF, EXPO BUILD PROOF, APK ARTIFACT, HEALTH PROOF, FAILED ITEMS, REMAINING ITEMS, ACCEPTANCE CHECKLIST)

3. Owner actions: (1) Apple credentials, (2) Google Play signing key, (3) physical device QA, (4) factory infrastructure + FA-01..50
